name: Pluginos Figma Operations Platform
description:
Run any Figma operation from any LLM agent at ~230 tokens per call instead of ~28,000 — a 15× cost reduction on real design workflows.
PluginOS bridges your Figma files to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP-compatible agent through 5 focused tools that discover operations on demand. No giant tool schemas bloating context. No raw node dumps confusing your agent.

⚠️ Requires the free PluginOS Bridge plugin running in Figma:
👉 https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1626608701431483287

Open it once before your first agent call, it auto-reconnects after that.

- 5 MCP tools, unlimited operations, discovered dynamically at runtime
- ~6,600 tokens per multi-step workflow vs ~105,000 with traditional approaches
- Pre-summarized, structured results: your agent reasons faster with less noise
- 28 built-in operations: lint, audit, content, components, accessibility, more
- Custom operations: add a manifest + execute pair, no server changes
- Multi-file support: connect several Figma files at once
Compatible with Claude Desktop (one-click DXT install), Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP client.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `pluginos-figma` (Use when performing any Figma task via MCP) and **1 MCP server**, `pluginos`.

Installs with `claude plugin install pluginos-figma-operations-platform@claude-community` from `LSDimi/PluginOS` (`packages/claude-plugin`).

Claude Code plugin that bundles the PluginOS MCP server registration and the `pluginos-figma` skill.
